name: Dosquebradas (Colombia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, yellow above and green below, charged at the centre with a black cog wheel.
history: Municipal flag of Dosquebradas, a municipality in the department of Risaralda, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor. Spanish Wikipedia records the flag as adopted on 5 April 1983 (acuerdo n.º 5).
